WELLBORE ST 00 BP 00 IS P/A. WILL DRILL ST 01 BP 00.
This EOR closes out the APM approved to PB to ST on 11/1/2011 and APM approved on 12/17/2011 to complete ST 00 BP 00 - which was  supposed to be for (wellbore ST 01 BP 00) which was spudded after this APM was approved. A new APM to complete ST 01 BP 00 was submitted on 1/6/12 and an APM was approved on 1/6/12 to cancel the APM approved on 12/17/2011. This EOR appears to be the only way to eliminate APM on 12/17/2011.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the VR 131 Well No. 21ST to produce the "6-A2" Sand. The previous completion, the "6-C" Sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP at 9,952' MD and dumping 51' of cement on top of plug, w/ ETOC at 9,901' MD. The "6-A2" Sand was perforated at interval 9,848'-9,861' MD. Operations began 09/30/2011 and ended 10/05/2011.

Stone has successfully performed zone change operations on the VR 255 OCS G-01152, Well No. H005 to produce the H-1/H-1A Sd. Operations began on May 3, 2007 and were completed on May 15, 2007. The previous producing interval in the well, the "H-2" Sd. was isolated by setting a "Posi-set" plug in the 7 5/8" casing @ 8640' & dumping 20' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 8620'. The H-1/H-1A zone was perforated @ 8372' - 8380' & 8511' - 8527' to production.

This EOR is filed to closeout a partial completion of work performed under APM apprved on 8/22/2012. The 36", 16" and 10 3/4" were cut and the 16" and 10 3/4" pulled. The 36" remains cut only. Another APM will be filed to pull the 36" as it was not pulled in this approved APM.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 06/16/2025.

*eWell recognizes a TA date of 09/25/1967 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug*

Stone has successfully drilling and completed for the production the SS 117 #4ST well.  The well was spud on 03-05-12 by cutting a window in the 9 5/8" csg @ 4916' MD and drilled to a TD on 03-21-12 at a depth of 10827' MD / 10290' TVD.  MW at TD was 12.5 ppg OBM.

7" production csg was set at TD and the well completed as single non-gravel packed gas completion in the "C9/10 Lwr" Sd, with perforations of 10712' - 10785' MD.

The 7" x 10-3/4" x 16" x 24" drive pipe were recovered from 20' BML on 03/12/2024.

Note: eWell reflects a "permanent abandonment" date of 03/22/1974 and does not allow for updates.  The well was temporarily abandoned through the surface plug as of 03/22/1974, however, casings/conductor were not recovered until 2024 and therefore the true date of permanent abandonment is 03/12/2024.

The cement plugs on this well were placed by a previous operator; therefore, McMoRan has no records on the date of the plugs.  The only operation McMoRan performed on this well was all casings were cut @ 20-ft BML on 03/26/2012.

ERT has completed the temporary abandonment of the SS 224 PP2 well.  Operations began on 05-03-09 and concluded on 05-14-09.  The well will be permanently abandoned when the SS PP plaformm is decommissioned.

Per the approved APM, Anadarko permitted to attempt to open the XRFV in the Amp 2 Lower, flow test the Amp 2 Lower, and then change to the Amp 2 Upper. Anadarko was able to achieve a successful negative test. Anadarko is currently only producing the Amp 2 Upper.

Anadarko set the optional pump-thru plug in the XRFV to isolate the Amp 2 Lower. The plug was set above the Amp 2 Lower mechanical sleeve. The sleeve for the Amp 2 Lower is a Superior X-Radial Flow Valve. Anadarko achieved a successful test on the plug, so we know the Amp 2 Lower is isolated. 

First we ran a check set tool that showed the plug was actually set. Then we performed the negative test by pulling > 500 psi off the plug and holding.

Since Anadarko has the lower frac pack isolated via plug and the successful negative test, then a commingling application has not been submitted to date. Should Anadarko decide to produce both the Amp 2 Lower and Amp 2 Upper in the future, then BSEE-Rate Control would be consulted prior to doing so.

This well was Temporarily abandoned 10/22/2020, while on location the decision was made to PA the well.  An RPM was approved to PA the well but the variance is still not approved.  Decision made to leave this well as TA and submit a new PA permit spring 2021 to complete the PA while we await the decision on the variance.

This well was previously TA by setting a plug inside the tubing on 07/09/2010.  Recently the plug began leaking, an APM was approved to set a plug on top of the existing plug, which was done on 02/22/2011 in order to re-establish the TA status on this well.

Left as TA. The well was cut at 20' below mudline and left with the platform since it was cemented to the 36" protector sleeve that is attached to the platform. The 36" x 26" annulus was grouted in 2003 to repair the 26" conductor.

Due to the inability to lockout the SCSSV, Talos has elected to suspend operations on this well indefinitely.  The well will require a specialty tool to attempt to lockout the SCSSV.  A new APM & WAR series will be filed prior to getting back on this well.

Operations were successfully completed for Zone Change to Q-Sand. Operations commenced on 03/30/2013 and was
completed 04/07/2013. R-Sand was isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 16,525'MD and dumping 52'cmt, ETOC=16,473'MD. Pressure tested cmt plug @ 16,473'MD to 1000psi. Fish stuck in hole @ 16,440'WLM. The Q-Sand was open to production by perforating intervals, 16,300'-16,340'MD.

Stone Energy has successfully performed operations for reinstatement of gas injection service into the A-14(LS) H-Sand (7588'-7608') on 04/22/2014, as required to allow the MP288 Platform to come on line.

The MC 109 A15ST1 was spud on 04-18-10.  The well was drilled to a total depth of 9656' MD / 6063' TVD w/a MW of 12.4 ppg SBM.  Hole problems and lost circulation problems were encounted. The well was plugged back for by-pass operations.

The well was plugged back by setting an inflatable cmt retainer @ 5109' MD and setting 1524' balance cmt plug on top of the retainer, ETOC @ 3585'.  A 9 5/8" EZSV was then set at 3438' and 400 sxs of cmt were squeezed below to retainer to set a cmt plug from 3585' - 3438'MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 05-25-10.

The EOR is filed to closeout a partial completion of work perfromed under APM approved on 8/22/12. The 7" and 9 5/8" were cut and pulled. The 30", 20", and 13 3/8" had been partially cut but have yet to be pulled. Another APM will be filed ot pull the 20", 30", and 13 3/8" as it was not pulled in this approved APM.

Stone Energy successfully completed operations to enhance production from ST 100, OCS-G-05599, Well A-7D by installing a live GLV @ 3161' MD to establish production from the current "CD" Sand interval, perfs 3544' - 3557' MD.  This live GLV was used solely to kick the well off to production; it will not be used for sustaining production on ST 100, Well A-7D.  These operations began on March 4, 2009 and were completed on March 5, 2009.

Stone has successfully completed zone chane operations on the SS 198 G-13ST well to produce the "LN" sand. The previous completion, the "LO" sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP at 11,890' MD and dumping 52' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 11,838' MD. The "LN" sand was perforated at intervals 11,786'-11,790' & 11,808'-11,820' MD. Operations began on 09/25/2010 and ended on 04/17/2011.
